subject.title: fix: support macos remote password auth ui

question: Should this external draft be held for contributor macOS proof, or should a maintainer supply a proof override after personally validating the Settings/onboarding password path?
rationale: The code shape is plausible and focused, but repository policy treats external PR real-behavior proof as a merge gate for this user-visible macOS credential flow.

options.title: Require macOS proof before merge
options.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot or recording plus Swift test or terminal output showing the password-auth Settings/onboarding path and preservation behavior.

options.title: Maintainer proof override
options.body: A maintainer can personally validate the same macOS behavior and explicitly override the contributor proof gate.

options.title: Pause the draft
options.body: Leave the PR open but unmergeable until the author marks it ready and adds proof.

recommendation.title: Require macOS proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot or recording plus Swift test or terminal output showing the password-auth Settings/onboarding path and preservation behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame points to recent work across the macOS remote config and gateway-auth files touched by this PR.
